verdict.rationale: Avalara documents Exemption Certificate Management (CertCapture) to collect, validate, and store exemption certificates for audits. AvaTax also claims support for exemption logic during calculation. However, nothing shows expiry tracking, and nothing explicitly shows stored certificates being applied automatically at AvaTax calculation time. ECM is documented as a separate companion product. missing for 10: certificate expiry tracking, documented automatic application of stored certificates at calculation time, resale-certificate specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time

citations.quote: Exemption Certificate Management (ECM), also known as CertCapture, helps you collect, validate, and store exemption certificates in one place. It reduces manual work and keeps certificate data accurate and easy to retrieve for audits.
Support scenarios such as product taxability differences, exemption logic, shipping rules, and temporary tax changes without building custom rule engines.
